observations: Two black flat-silhouette figures face each other against a solid red field; their raised arms meet at center to form a heart shape outlined in black.
Yellow spiral-and-circle eyes appear on both figures, and jagged yellow zigzag lines radiate outward across the red background.
A thick black band fills the lower quarter of the image; the artist's signature appears in red within that band at the bottom left.
reading: Two flat black figures hold a heart shape between them, their spiral eyes lit yellow against red. The radiating zigzag lines fill the field with restless energy, yet the central gesture reads as tender. The image holds warmth and unease at once — affection rendered in forms that feel feral rather than soft.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between nnotb #57 — a dense, dark, open-mouthed figure on black — and nnotb #59, a heavily worked creature on yellow. The flat red field and paired figures mark a distinct mood from both immediate neighbors.

connections.reason: nnotb #57 shares the spiral-eye and jagged-tooth-line motifs but uses dense layered marks on black rather than flat silhouettes on red, making the contrast in surface approach visible.

lookingQuestion: The zigzag lines spread outward from both figures equally — do they seem to come from the figures, or does the field itself appear to pulse around them?
ambiguities: nnotb #59 shares a yellow-dominant palette but its subject and marks differ enough that no strong formal connection to #58 is supported beyond title adjacency.
nifty faces #40 belongs to a different owned collection family; no specific formal element in the inspected image justifies a connection over the nnotb #57 match.
